topics.label: 🌍 Geopolitics
topics.describe: Wars, diplomacy, sanctions, elections and power politics between countries, and major international crises.

topics.label: 🇺🇸 US economy
topics.describe: US macro economy and policy: inflation, the Fed and interest rates, GDP, trade and tariffs, and markets only when they reflect macro news.

topics.label: 💼 US job market
topics.describe: US labor market only: jobs reports and payrolls, unemployment and jobless claims, layoffs, hiring trends, wages, job openings. Not general economy news.

feeds.name: Google News
feeds.gnews: ("jobs report" OR "jobless claims" OR payrolls OR layoffs OR "job openings" OR JOLTS OR "unemployment rate") US when:2d

topics.label: 🇦🇷 Argentina economy
topics.describe: Argentina's economy and economic policy: inflation, exchange rate, reserves, country risk, BCRA, IMF, fiscal and government economic measures.

topics.label: 🤖 AI
topics.describe: Artificial intelligence: new models and products, major lab news (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Meta), research breakthroughs, regulation, AI business deals.

topics.label: 🎮 Videogames
topics.describe: Video game releases, industry news, major studio and platform news, notable reviews and announcements.

topics.label: 🎬 Movies
topics.describe: Film: releases, box office, casting and production news, festival and awards news, notable trailers.

topics.label: 🏠 US real estate
topics.describe: US housing and real estate: home prices, sales, mortgage rates, rents, housing policy, commercial real estate.

topics.label: 🌴 Miami & Florida
topics.describe: Miami and Florida local news: city and state politics, development and real estate, economy, weather and hurricanes, crime and safety, culture and events.

feeds.name: Miami outlets
feeds.gnews: (site:miamiherald.com OR site:local10.com OR site:wlrn.org OR site:nbcmiami.com) when:2d

feeds.name: Google News
feeds.gnews: (Miami OR Florida OR "Miami-Dade" OR DeSantis) when:2d
